scopeDescriptions.scheme: Only TestAction shouldUseLaunchSchemeArgsEnv changes YES to NO, making its existing HANLIN_UNIT_TEST_HOST=1 effective. LaunchAction/ProfileAction, production host gates and test assertions unchanged.
scopeDescriptions.checker: Only NativeScript built-app inspection helper, preflight integration and nine focused regression fixtures. Original app/runtime/linker/metadata producer unchanged.
scopeDescriptions.fixture: Only test fixture temp-directory canonicalization with realpath for macOS /var to /private/var aliases; checker behavior and test assertions unchanged.

preservedOriginalChecks: Exact original Core/runtime dependency-lock and closure versions
SwiftUI plugin integrity/version/provider and prepared runtime-file hashes
Required NativeScript/NSCWinterTC/TNSWidgets frameworks and Mach-O shape
Real Objective-C SwiftUI provider registration checked with otool -ov
Provider-name strings check on the same image that passed the Objective-C check
Prepared fixture package/provenance and plugin-free Core requirements
Canonical build-define checks for prepared runtime modules
checkerFindings: Verified linked direct main-bundle image closure adds Xcode debug dylib metadata ownership without admitting framework or unlinked metadata.
Canonical paths are deduplicated, direct main-bundle-parent scope is enforced, and actual loader/executable/runpath resolution is retained.
Exact __DATA/__TNSMetadata section and positive BigInt size are required, with exactly one owner per loaded architecture; fat slices are not counted as duplicate host images.
Provider candidates gain the verified host paths while preserving the existing embedded-framework scan and same-provider strings assertion.
fingerprintScope: Scheme, checker and fixture paths are outside reviewed SDK explicit/recursive inputs, source-inventory inputs and Host/native input roots; no production producer or package refresh implied.

selectedCaseIndependence.basis: The engine cases author isolated index.ts/echo.ts fixtures through MiniAppAuthoringTool and use production assistant exports; reply/cancellation cases instantiate NativeScriptHostServicesAdapter directly. Neither parity-demo helpers nor modular-text-search UI is loaded by these cases.

boundedCompletedOwnerFollowup.excluded: No active-owner working files or later changes imported; immutable diff-path classification only.

validationBoundary.passClaims: None. Native execution results belong to separate original Mac receipts; this document records source review and input scope only.
